title: MotionLabStoryboard
description: Stage 1 scene plan for standard and complex projects: timed scenes with purpose, on-screen text, layout intent per format, catalogue capabilities, transitions and audio cues. Instance file: projects/<slug>/storyboard.json.

styleframes.description: Still frames reviewed before the full render (paths relative to the project).

purpose.description: What this scene must communicate or make the viewer feel.

why.description: The scene's job in the story, traced back to the brief's core message (for example: 'Lands the value claim', 'Evidence that the controller faced the internet'). A scene whose why cannot be traced to the message is a scene to cut. Read by `studio.py script`, which prints the storyboard as a Frame | On screen | Why table.

on_screen_text.description: Every card, label, legend, definition and source line the scene shows, 6 words or fewer each in portrait. It carries the information the narration skips: anything named in the narration or on screen is explained here or in the narration, and nothing drawn is anonymous (story-writer rulebook 3.6, from the owner's review of game-theory-trust, 2026-11-07).

pace.description: The scene's place in the film's pace map (story-writer rulebook 3.5). slow: the turn, the proof, a new concept or a key number (speed about 0.90-0.95, at most about 90% of the word cap, a beat of silence after the payoff). normal: context (the film speed, the cap). fast: recap, transitions, the loop line (about 1.10-1.15, up to about 110% of the cap, no new term or number). The matching number is the scene's `speed` in src/narration.json. Optional and additive; added 2026-11-07 without a spec_version change.

capabilities.description: Catalogue IDs (primitives, effects, recipes, compositions) the scene uses.

at_sec.description: Film time in seconds (not time since the scene started). style_templates.beat_gaps still reads scene-relative beats, because older storyboards use them.

continuity.description: What carries the eye across the cut (shape, colour, position).

beat_id.description: Beat in beatmap.json this scene realises (optional).

style_variant.description: Scene variant id from the project design profile (optional).

intent.description: Declared intent; 'still' and 'minimal' waive the matching automatic QA findings and the waiver is reported.

asset_refs.description: Asset library ids used by this scene (optional).

caption_lane.description: Where captions sit during this scene, when the default is wrong: upper when the key visual, a source line or a call to action occupies the lower third. Omit for the default (hook window mid in portrait, then lower). Portrait has all three lanes; landscape and square have lower and upper. See docs/caption-design.md.
